description: This file contains an abstract class 'Striped64' which implements a thread-safe, lazily-initialized striped counter mechanism using atomic operations, padding, and contention management strategies. It is part of internal caching infrastructure in the Orleans project.

classes.name: Striped64
classes.description: An internal abstract class implementing a striped counter with contention management, atomic updates, and lazy table initialization.

classes.name: Striped64.Cell
classes.description: A nested sealed class representing a padded atomic long used as a cell in the striped counter table.

methods.name: CasCellsBusy
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock for resizing or initializing the cells array using CAS.

methods.name: VolatileWriteNotBusy
methods.description: Releases the lock by setting the _cellsBusy field to 0.

methods.name: GetProbe
methods.description: Returns a thread-specific pseudo-random probe value based on the thread ID.

methods.name: AdvanceProbe
methods.description: Advances the thread's probe value using xorshift for secondary hashing.

methods.name: LongAccumulate
methods.description: Handles atomic accumulation of a value into the striped counter, managing contention, resizing, and fallback to base.
